name: Dueling Grace (Combat)
body:
You strike elegantly and precisely with your piercing weapons.

Prerequisite(s): Canny defense class feature, Weapon Finesse, Weapon Focus with chosen weapon.

Benefit(s): Choose one kind of one-handed piercing weapon (such as the trident). You gain the swashbuckler finesse ability with the selected weapon, and you can add your Dexterity modifier instead of your Strength modifier to that weapon’s damage. The weapon must be one appropriate for your size.
